profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ LinkedIn | Computer Science
profile.summary:
With a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from The University of British Columbia and over two decades of experience in software engineering, I have developed expertise in designing, testing, and optimizing software solutions across various platforms. My professional journey includes impactful roles at Microsoft, Expedia, and LinkedIn. From building automation frameworks to enhancing developer experiences for AI products, I have consistently contributed to innovation and efficiency within the tech industry.

At LinkedIn, we connect professionals worldwide to foster productivity and success. As the world's largest professional network with over 1 billion members globally—including executives from every Fortune 500 company—we offer comprehensive Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions services. Our mission is rooted in empowering global professionals through diversified tools that drive meaningful connections. Contact me if you’d like to learn more about how LinkedIn creates transformative opportunities for businesses and individuals alike!

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized code for Android applications and APIs, enhancing performance and user experience.  
• Spearheaded the implementation of new features for AI products, driving innovation and customer satisfaction.  
• Improved developer experience for the Premium team, streamlining workflows and increasing productivity.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
Developed end to end test solution using Java to solve complex test problems and use statistic approach to measure software quality
Developed front end reporting using ASP.Net, Java Script, JQuery with SQL as back end storage 
Developed test automation for web services APIs and web site with Java, Selenium, Python

Experience in agile development

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Test II
positions.description:
Responsible for creating test plans and feature-test specifications, and defining the test process for the Windows Performance Analysis Tool and Component Platform Team specializing in scalability, accessibility and performance.
Accountable for meeting the quality goals and delivering test automation result analysis for signoff decision.
Influenced product design to meet customers’ needs.
Designed and implemented a user interface test automation framework using C# that served as the test foundation for a team of six test engineers.
Delivered test automation for various Operating System servicing technologies involving Microsoft Installer (MSI) and a number of internal Operating System image construction tools with C/C++.
Developed data mining reports using SQL, ASP and SQL Reporting Service that have been widely adopted by partner teams and the test leadership team.
Lead a virtual team of five engineers to drive a cross-group project to centralize test execution, triage and report results for a group of 30 engineers. Responsible for allocating resources, driving best engineering practices and resolving conflicts
Completed two major product release cycles.
